items.text: Research self-driving mobility scooters.
items.notes:
While at The Big Breakfast yesterday, 
I browsed the callender and saw one of my
work mates in an old wheelchair. Stevie, was 
always in a mobility scooter for as long as I've 
known him. I was informed that he's been 
downgraded to a wheelchair for saftey reasons. 
Apparently his eyesight has deteriorated to the 
point that his scooter driving is a public 
danger. That got me thinking about self-driving 
scooters. Aprently they exist but they're like 
$5-7,000. What if our little GHOST AI in TernOO 
on a Raspi, were trained to use vision and 
infra-red sensors to drive a retro-fitted 
scooter? Perhaps a self-driving retro fit kit 
could be made for just a few $100 to a $1,000.

items.text: Make Default Aplication Feature Checklist.
items.notes:
Things like text boxes allways need to be made 
with refference to default inheritance sets. 
Perhaps a refference tool with nested list and a
Venn diagram view of our emerging object model 
would help. But text boxes should have context 
menus with cut/copy/paste and undo/redo if and 
where relevnt. Another text box default item is 
word wrap. This tool is presently not word 
wrapping. Then there's spell check. Not all 
these feeatures are nescecarily relevant in 
some cases, but many are warrented as default 
and should be assumed as defult unless 
otherwise speified.
